title: Jobs stay pending forever when the fallback cannot submit to a disabled Batch queue
description:
When the budget guard (or the kill-switch) disables the Batch job queue, the fallback state machine's `SubmitGpuJob` task fails. It has no Catch, so the execution fails and the job row stays `pending` with no `error_message` or `failed_at`. The player polls forever and the operator console shows nothing wrong.

Fix: add a Catch on `SubmitGpuJob` that conditionally (`status = pending`) marks the job `failed` with `error_message = batch_submit_failed` and `failed_at`, then ends the execution in a Fail state. Specified in `features/spend_guardrails.feature`.
